name: The Princess Wears a Wig! Xtreme Yanking Zone
source:
I am Princess Wyrena Sarvaris. Future queen, beacon of poise, pillar of grace, and proud possessor of absolutely real and naturally voluminous hair.

...I said that in jest. My hair was burned off by a blue-haired gremlin. It's now replaced by a wig.

This is the story of how my father decided to host a multi-night royal ball to marry me off like a prized cow at auction. How the nobility paraded like overdressed peacocks. How three potential suitors vied for my hand: a prince so dramatic he speaks in riddles, a wolf so uncouth he steals food from the castle kitchen, and my judgmental knight who is internally dying.

And me? I am tasked with attending the Grand Ball for my debutante while trying to dodge dramatic wind, tail swipes, allergic sneezes, and most harrowing of all... keeping my wig firmly attached.

[From [url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/the-princess-wears-a-wig-xyz]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我是维雷娜·萨瓦里斯公主。未来的女王、风度的灯塔、优雅的支柱，以及自豪地拥有绝对真实、自然浓密的头发。

……我是开玩笑地说的。我的头发被蓝发小魔怪烧掉了。现在已经被假发取代了。

这是一个关于我父亲如何决定举办一个持续多晚的皇家舞会的故事，目的是将我像拍卖会上的一头珍贵的牛一样结婚。贵族们如何像盛装打扮的孔雀一样游行。三个潜在的追求者如何争夺我的手：一位戏剧性的王子，他会说谜语，一只狼，他粗鲁地从城堡厨房里偷食物，还有我的审判骑士，他的内心快要死了。

而我呢？我的任务是参加我的初次亮相的盛大舞会，同时努力躲避剧烈的风、尾巴的摆动、过敏性喷嚏，以及最令人痛苦的……保持我的假发牢固地固定住。

[来自[url=https://azurextwilight.itch.io/the-princess-wears-a-wig-xyz]itch.io[/url]]
